questions.prompt: Какой вариант соответствует паттерну advise + object + to-infinitive?

choices.text: She advised to take a break.
She advised him going home.
She advised him to take a break.
She advised that he should take a break.

questions.explanation: В c используется целевой паттерн advised him to take. That-clause в d тоже грамматичен, но относится к другой модели.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант соответствует правилу 'advise + object + to-infinitive'?

choices.text: The manager advised to finish the project.
The manager advised the team to finish the project.
The manager advised the team finishing the project.
The manager advised the team that they should finish.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант содержит ошибку в использовании 'advise'?

choices.text: She advised me to update the app.
She advised me update the app.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант соответствует паттерну 'advise + object + to-infinitive'?

choices.text: He advised to call the doctor.
He advised her to call the doctor.
He advised her calling the doctor.
He advised her that she should call.

questions.explanation: Advised her to call — целевой паттерн. Advise допускает и другие конструкции, но вопрос проверяет эту модель.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант соответствует структуре 'advise + object + to-infinitive'?

choices.text: The teacher advised to read the book.
The teacher advised the class to read the book.
The teacher advised the class reading the book.
The teacher advised the class that they should read.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант ошибочно использует to-infinitive после advise без объекта?

choices.text: They advised him to leave early.
They advised to leave early.
They advised him leaving early.
They advised him that he should leave.

questions.explanation: В b активный advise непосредственно сочетается с to leave без адресата. Для этого паттерна нужен объект: advised him to leave.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант соответствует паттерну 'advise + object + to-infinitive'?

choices.text: She advised the team to meet tomorrow.
She advised to meet tomorrow.
She advised the team meeting tomorrow.
She advised the team that they should meet.

questions.explanation: Advised the team to meet — целевой паттерн с объектом и to-infinitive.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант ошибочно использует to-infinitive после advise без объекта?

choices.text: The doctor advised him to take medicine.
The doctor advised to take medicine.
The doctor advised him taking medicine.
The doctor advised him that he should take medicine.

questions.explanation: В b отсутствует адресат перед to take. Нужен объект либо другая конструкция с advise.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант соответствует паттерну 'advise + object + to-infinitive'?

choices.text: They advised us to be careful.
They advised to be careful.
They advised us being careful.
They advised us that we should be careful.

questions.explanation: Advised us to be careful — целевой паттерн. Advise также допускает V-ing и that-clause в подходящем контексте.

questions.prompt: Какой вариант соответствует паттерну 'advise + object + to-infinitive'?

choices.text: The advisor advised the client to sign the contract.
The advisor advised to sign the contract.
The advisor advised the client signing the contract.
The advisor advised the client that they should sign.

questions.explanation: Advised the client to sign — целевой паттерн с адресатом совета.
